prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. Pick up object, move to location, check properties of object, do specific task. If unable, approach object or scan area. list of available nodes: <Action ID = PickupObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToLocation    /> <Condition ID = CheckObjectProperty    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectApproached    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectVisible    /> <SubTree ID = ProcessObject    /> <Action ID = ApproachObject    /> <Action ID = ScanAreaForObject    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
			IF IsObjectApproached? THEN
			DO PickupObject
	ELSE
		DO MoveToLocation
			IF CheckObjectProperty? THEN
			DO SpecificTask
	END
